title: NYC Artist Coalition shared-folder archival production
objective: Account for the complete accessible snapshot, develop useful source-backed knowledge, and project only claims that preserve privacy, rights, collective credit, and outcome boundaries.
population_contract: 100 percent means inventory, classification, and one primary disposition for every item reachable in the authenticated snapshot. It does not mean full-content review, rights clearance, publication, or historical completeness outside the accessible population.

evals.title: Accessible population closes exactly
pass_criteria: Population, inventory, classification, and disposition totals all equal 2,078
Folder and non-folder totals reconcile to the population
The 61-item root reconciles as 47 folders and 14 loose files

evals.title: Traversal exceptions are adjudicated
pass_criteria: All 253 folders have a final traversal state
Twenty initial exceptions resolve as 18 empty and two recovered folders
The recursive queue closes at zero

evals.title: Every item has one primary disposition
pass_criteria: Disposition counts sum to 2,078
Format counts sum to 2,078
The public aggregate and protected manifest digest agree on coverage

evals.title: Protected-source boundary has no decoded leak path
pass_criteria: No Drive or Docs URL, resource key, exact local path, email address, item list, or owner display enters the public artifacts
The private manifest is represented only by an opaque digest and protected source pointers
No raw close-reading text enters Git

evals.title: Census and close reading remain distinct
pass_criteria: The dossier defines 100 percent as accounting and disposition
It separately reports 36 close-read records and zero errors
It names excluded populations and the failed ZIP attempt without treating either as a closed historical universe

evals.title: Collective credit survives claim promotion
pass_criteria: Jamie's co-writer and public-testimony actions are named directly
Coalition members, collaborators, partner groups, officials, agencies, and legislative bodies retain distinct credit
No selected claim assigns sole authorship or individual policy causality

evals.title: Selected claims have public corroboration and anti-claims
pass_criteria: Two claims are selected
Each selected claim has at least one public corroborating source relationship
Each selected claim declares boundaries and anti-claims

evals.title: High-value incomplete claims remain held and tasked
pass_criteria: Town-hall production and FairRent web-implementation candidates have hold projections
MARCH metric validation has a reproducible research task
Rights and consent have an explicit queue

evals.title: Portfolio and application projections are useful and bounded
pass_criteria: The civic case study renders both selected claims through the canonical claim graph
Technical Operations renders the machine-readable civic-design projection
The application brief separates ready language, held language, role translation, and anti-claims

evals.title: Knowledge depth does not create a public archive route
pass_criteria: No public Knowledge Wiki, knowledge-bank, public-claims, or proofs route exists
The website remains a selected projection of the private/public knowledge lifecycle
Access and census depth never imply publication approval
